source.author: verg
source.text: Huc omnis turba ad ripas effusa ruebat, matres atque viri, defunctaque corpora vita magnanimum heroum, pueri innuptaeque puellae, impositique rogis iuvenes ante ora parentum:
source.text_original: Huc omnis turba ad ripas effusa ruebat, / matres atque viri, defunctaque corpora vita / magnanimum heroum, pueri innuptaeque puellae, / impositique rogis iuvenes ante ora parentum: /
source.text_english: Here all the throng was streaming forth to the banks, mothers and men, and the lifeless bodies of the great-hearted heroes, boys and unmarried girls, and youths placed upon the pyres before the faces of their parents:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mirantur tantos strepitus turbamque ruentem et loca et infernos almae virtutis honores.
reuse.text_original: mirantur tantos strepitus turbamque ruentem / et loca et infernos almae virtutis honores.
reuse.text_english: They marvel at such great noises and the crowd rushing in, and at the places and the honors of almighty valor below.
